title: Stop quadratic registered-check scans during live acceptance preflight
outcome: Stop quadratic registered-check scans during live acceptance preflight
acceptance: Live acceptance preflight (evaluate and done) finds the newest applicable registered check with one pass over the item's registered checks: the matching_on → passing_candidate_on → newer_failed_on path no longer rescans, or materialises a suffix, once per older superseded pass

A behaviour test with many superseded passes and a newer failure shows the preflight's work grows linearly with the number of registered checks, and that the outcome (newest applicable result, newer failure wins) is unchanged
No new check, flag or cache table; the change only removes the repeated scan
